sections: Hiring Across Borders, Without the Barriers
Tiered Pricing That Scales With You
From Kickoff to Candidates in 14 Days
Ready to Transform Your Hiring at Scale?
textBlocks: AI-powered recruiting infrastructure for companies hiring at scale. Top 10 ranked candidates delivered every week — remote, on-site, or willing to relocate. Visa support included for UAE and US markets. Custom billing available.
Traditional agencies charge 20–30% per hire. At scale, that's millions wasted. We deliver the same quality at a fraction of the cost — with full pipeline transparency.
Source talent across 30+ countries. Remote, on-site, or willing to relocate.
Bi-weekly candidate drops with ranked shortlists and fit scoring.
Full visa processing support for UAE and US markets. Relocation coordination included.
You own every candidate profile, every pipeline insight. No lock-in.
Real-time dashboards with sourcing metrics, response rates, and quality trends.
A dedicated recruiter pod assigned to your account for consistency and speed.
From hotel chains to retail rollouts, we power hiring for the world's most demanding operations.
Major hotel chains, resorts, cruise lines
At 50 hires/month with an average salary of $80K, traditional agencies cost $800K–$1.2M/month. With TaaSFlow, you pay a flat subscription.
See exactly how much you save vs. agency fees and internal sourcing costs at enterprise scale.
The more you hire, the less you pay per role. No placement fees, no hidden costs.
Needed 120+ staff across 3 new properties in 90 days
Delivered 140 qualified candidates with visa processing support. All positions filled on time.
Seasonal hiring surge: 200+ positions across 15 locations
Systematic sourcing across time zones with bi-weekly drops. 95% fill rate achieved.
Specialized roles across engineering, safety, and operations
Sourced niche talent globally with relocation support. Average time-to-fill: 18 days.
Deep-dive into your workforce plan, volumes, locations, and timelines.
We map every role with scoring weights, must-haves, and targeting strategy.
AI-powered sourcing across LinkedIn, job boards, referral networks, and direct outreach.
Ranked shortlists delivered every 14 days with fit scores, availability, and visa status.
Feedback loops refine targeting. Quality improves every cycle.
Built careers advising global enterprises. Now applying that same rigor to the world of hiring.

25 years' experience of designing and driving value creation across Fortune 500s and Private Equity. Former Director at UBS Investment Bank and has led strategic programmes for Google, Barclays, HSBC, IBM and AstraZeneca. Very pragmatic and always looking to challenge and disrupt using technology as a key enabler. Strong experience in working directly with leadership teams, enabling growth and execution of business strategy.

Former strategist for Hilton, Marriott, Four Seasons, and Philips. Represented at G20 and B20 forums. Has built and scaled talent acquisition campaigns across the US, LATAM, Europe, and the Gulf. Passionate about employer branding, global talent markets, and building real connections at scale.
Join enterprise teams that have replaced agency dependency with predictable, top 10 ranked weekly talent shortlists. Let's build your workforce plan.
No commitment required. 30-minute strategy session with our founding team.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

We use essential cookies for core functionality. With your consent, we use analytics (Google Analytics) and marketing technologies (Meta Pixel, Apollo, Retention.com/RB2B) to understand website performance, improve campaigns, and measure conversions safely. Your data is processed in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Notice. You can change your preferences at any time.

h1: Hire at scale on one transparent operating system.

headings.text: Hire at scale on one transparent operating system.
Let’s scope your hiring plan together.

sections: Hire at scale on one transparent operating system.
Let’s scope your hiring plan together.
textBlocks: Enterprise TaaSFlow is the same product, sized for organisations running many searches in parallel across teams, geographies and business units. One workspace, one source of truth, one accountable team.
Run many searches in parallel with shared brief conventions, shared scoring standards, and one workspace per business unit.
Source across geographies and time zones. Remote, on-site, and — where approved for the role — relocation-friendly candidates.
Everyone in the account sees the same pipeline, the same evidence, the same decisions. No hidden queues, no side channels.
Roll-up views of pipeline health, stage velocity, source mix and decision outcomes across roles, teams and business units.
Multiple positions, teams and hiring managers under one organisation. Fine-grained roles: admin, editor, viewer.
Invoicing aligned to your finance process: purchase orders, consolidated billing, and multi-currency where supported.
Row-level tenant isolation, per-role permissions, private CV storage with signed short-lived URLs, and a full audit trail.
A named account contact, direct messaging inside every workspace, and joint reviews on a cadence you set.
01Scoping conversationWe map roles, teams, geographies, and success criteria for the first quarter.
We map roles, teams, geographies, and success criteria for the first quarter.
02Account setupOrganisation, workspaces, roles, and billing are configured before any role goes live.
Organisation, workspaces, roles, and billing are configured before any role goes live.
03Rolling executionRoles are submitted through the standard intake and delivered into the shared workspace.

Book a consultation and we’ll come back with a tailored account structure and price.
